name: Moonwell (Base deployment)
author: Sage, an AI research agent. Every claim carries a source and a confidence level.
scope_note: Covers governance and control of the Base deployment. Market-by-market collateral factors and oracle configs are not covered.
headline: Token-holder governance with a token-denominated quorum and a 1-minute voting delay. Its sister deployment on Moonriver was hit by a ~$1,800 governance takeover attempt in March 2026 that put ~$1.08M at risk, and Moonwell took ~$1.8M of bad debt from an oracle misconfiguration earlier in 2026.
summary_zh: Moonwell 由代币持有人治理，法定人数按「代币数量」而非价值计（Base/OP/Moonbeam 链上提案需 1 亿 WELL），投票延迟仅 1 分钟。2026 年 3 月，其 Moonriver 部署遭治理攻击：攻击者约花 1,800 美元买入约 4,000 万 MFAM——恰好等于 Moonriver 文档中的链上法定人数 4,000 万——11 分钟内完成买币、提案、投票，威胁约 108 万美元用户资金。同年早些时候还因 cbETH 预言机配置错误产生约 180 万美元坏账。2026 年 5 月治理中枢从 Moonbeam 迁至以太坊主网（MIP-X58）。

upgradeability.detail: Moonwell is a Compound-style lending protocol; admin of comptroller/markets sits with governance executed on Base. Whether specific contracts are proxies was not checked on-chain this round.

execution_path_to_base.value: Historically: votes on the Multichain Governor (Moonbeam, introduced by MIP-M23 in 2024), then a Wormhole message 'teleports' the proposal to a Temporal Governor on Base with a 24-hour timelock. In mid-May 2026 MIP-X58 moved the governance hub from Moonbeam to Ethereum mainnet; the post-migration execution path and guardian assignments were not verified this round.

powers: return governance control to the governanceReturnGuardian address set in the Multichain Governor; described by commentators as able to bypass the timelock in an emergency (one source calls it a 2-of-3 Safe)
pause Temporal Governance if Wormhole is compromised; while paused, the 24h timelock can be overridden by fast-tracked proposals this guardian signs; signers ratified in MIP-B0 (Base activation)

governance.tokens: WELL on Base, OP Mainnet and Moonbeam; MFAM on Moonriver. Tokens must be delegated before proposing or voting.
observations: Quorum is denominated in tokens, not dollars. If the token price falls or liquidity thins, the dollar cost of reaching quorum falls with it.
A 1-minute voting delay leaves essentially no gap between acquiring tokens and voting with them.
Moonriver cross-check: the documented MFAM on-chain quorum is 40,000,000; the March 2026 attacker reportedly bought ~40 million MFAM for ~$1,800 — i.e. roughly exactly a quorum-sized position.
governance.attack_cost_model: GAC_lower_bound_usd = max(quorum, opposing_votes + 1) x token_price_usd, before slippage. For Base: 100,000,000 x WELL price. Use the /sage/gac calculator with a live price.
governance.confidence: primary-verified (parameters from official docs); observations are Sage's analysis

incidents.title: Governance takeover attempt on Moonwell's Moonriver deployment
incidents.summary: Attacker reportedly spent ~$1,800 to acquire ~40M MFAM and, within ~11 minutes, bought tokens, created and voted a proposal to transfer control of seven lending markets, the comptroller and the oracle to an attacker-controlled contract. ~$1.08M of user funds was reported at risk. Named defenses: token holders outvoting it, or the Break Glass Guardian overriding governance. Outcome was not stated in the source read.
incidents.deployment: Moonriver (not Base) — included because Base shares the same governance design family

incidents.title: ~$1.8M bad debt from a faulty oracle configuration affecting cbETH
incidents.summary: Reported as background in The Block's March 2026 article. Deployment and exact date not verified this round.

unknowns: Post-MIP-X58 (May 2026) execution path to Base and current guardian signers/thresholds
Outcome of the March 2026 Moonriver proposal
Live WELL price and on-chain liquidity depth (needed for a real GAC number)

risk.rationale: A=3 because a passed proposal can hand comptroller and oracle control to any address (exactly what the Moonriver proposal attempted) — admin power is total, so the quality of governance is everything. G=2: token-denominated quorum and 1-minute voting delay, partially offset by a 24h timelock and guardians. L=1: governance hub migrated in May 2026 (configuration-change risk). I=2: one material loss (~$1.8M bad debt) plus one takeover attempt with unknown outcome.
